Temperature Sim

thermal physics sandbox · v1 t = 0.0 s

Bench · side view Drag up from the supply shelf onto the bench · drag an item back down to remove it

Controls

Temperature vs time · temp_c (°C)

Lumped-mass thermal model with latent-heat plateaus (fusion 334 kJ/kg, vaporisation 2 260 kJ/kg). Probe first-order lag τ = 3 s. Output channel temp_c in °C, sampled at 4 Hz. Physics core is headless and unit-tested (node --test).
